subject.title: fix(memory): recover from same-file legacy index divergence

question: Which same-file Memory Core migration candidate should land: this PR with the full Gateway/Doctor proof, or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/109865 with the original contributor’s implementation history?
rationale: Both branches address the same persisted-state failure and contain meaningful implementation and proof; selecting a permanent migration owner is a product and maintenance decision rather than a mechanical review repair.
